feed.summary: DICE HIGHLIGHT FLASH FIX (v405) — Wyatt reported a ~6-frame glitch after doubles where winners shrank and losers briefly grew before snapping back. Root cause: drainAbilityQueue post-callback at line 10688 called renderDice() then setTimeout(10) highlightWinnerDice. renderDice wipes innerHTML synchronously, highlight re-applies after timeout, so browser painted ONE neutral frame between where winners lost their scale(1.14) gold transform and losers lost their scale(0.94) fade — making losing dice appear to briefly 'become' winners. Fix: call highlightWinnerDice synchronously in the same tick after renderDice. Both DOM changes coalesce into one paint — no intermediate frame. Tie path at 8632 is unaffected (ties never call highlightWinnerDice, so no highlights to wipe).

feed.next_up: SUSPICIOUS JEFF (61) FIX — three issues: (1) TRIGGER TIMING: Current code at line 10358-10365 fires via 'hasSideline(winTeam, 61)' inside resolveRound's per-round winner path, meaning it stacks +1 steal EVERY time your ghost wins a roll. Intended: fires only when your active ghost DEFEATS (KOs) the enemy ghost. Move the trigger out of the per-round-win path and into the KO detection path — look for where enemy.ko transitions false→true via winTeam's damage, and fire Snicker there. hasSideline(winTeam, 61) check still applies. (2) STEAL SEMANTICS: Line 6784-6785 just subtracts: 'redCount = Math.max(1, redCount - B.jeffSnicker[tName])'. Same bug as Dallas — a steal should TRANSFER. When Jeff's team is blue, one red die becomes a blue die for the next roll: 'redCount = Math.max(1, redCount - N); blueCount += N'. feed.next_up: DALLAS FIX #1 (steal semantics): Quick Draw currently just SUBTRACTS from opponent dice count at line 6443-6456 (redCount = Math.max(1, redCount - 1)). Intended behavior: STEAL = transfer. Dallas's team gains that die, opponent loses it. If Dallas is red, one blue die becomes a red die for the roll. Implementation: when stealing, do BOTH sides — e.g. if enemyTName=='blue': blueCount = Math.max(1, blueCount-1); redCount++; Only the count transfer matters — dice are rolled fresh each round, there's no persistent 'which die' ownership. --- DALLAS FIX #2 (sideline-only trigger): Ability should ONLY fire when Dallas enters from the sideline (KO-swap or forced swap), NOT when he's the starting fighter in position 0. Currently triggerEntry() runs for starting fighters at battle-start (index.html line 3395-3399), which unconditionally sets f.dallasQuickDraw=2 at line 3585-3590. Compare to Raditz (62) at line 3573 which uses '!skipEntryEffects' guard — but that flag only covers Tyson's Hop, not starting-position. Need a new signal: either (a) set a per-team flag in startBattle() that suppresses sideline-only entry abilities on the first entry call, or (b) gate Dallas on something like 'this isn't round 1 starter' — check if B.round > 0 or use a battleStarted flag.
